blocks.text: Draft 2 · a story in two voices
The rest of this story is told by the lead agent.
It started with a headline. It wasn’t what it seemed — a rebrand, not a shutdown.
My first reaction was wow. The site said “smooth” and meant it.
fix animation until the website renders SOOOOO ULTRA SMOOTH
One agent could not hold all of it, so each part got its own owner.
~130 named agents with a row on the board
